FROZEN_TARGET.statement: For every reachable good HPS prefix s, deterministically decide the exact three-way sign of Delta_s(z_r)=p_s0(z_r)-p_s1(z_r) in {-1,0,+1} in r^O(1) bit operations and r^O(1) space, where z_r=rho+epsilon_r and the good-prefix invariant is imported from the frozen predecessor.

LEAF_DELTA_IDENTITY.setup: Fix a reachable prefix s, its genuine binary HPS decision, and a complete future suffix completion omega. HPS rank-one comparison supplies a common middle Hermitian matrix M_mid,omega and equal-norm vectors u_omega,v_omega so that, after choosing the frozen child orientation, M_0,omega=M_mid,omega+v_omega v_omega^* and M_1,omega=M_mid,omega+u_omega u_omega^*.
LEAF_DELTA_IDENTITY.rank_of_child_matrix_difference: rank(M_0,omega-M_1,omega)<=2; it is trace zero because ||u_omega||=||v_omega||.
LEAF_DELTA_IDENTITY.derivation: Use det(K-xx^*)=det(K)-x^*adj(K)x separately for the two siblings; the common det(K) term cancels before any suffix expectation is expanded.
LEAF_DELTA_IDENTITY.minimum_leaf_data: One exact adjugate/cofactor trace pairing with the trace-zero rank-at-most-two direction R_omega; neither child determinant needs to be materialized separately.
LEAF_DELTA_IDENTITY.degree_reduction: If each child characteristic polynomial has degree N, the leaf difference has degree at most N-2: the z^(N-1) adjugate term cancels because Tr(R_omega)=||u_omega||^2-||v_omega||^2=0.
LEAF_DELTA_IDENTITY.bit_complexity: For a fully fixed omega, N=O(r); exact determinant/adjugate-trace evaluation at the fixed-degree algebraic point z_r can be performed in r^O(1) bit operations provided the fixed matrix entries and z_r encoding have polynomial bit length. The vectors u,v need not be explicitly introduced if the rank-two direction R is kept exactly.

SUFFIX_AVERAGED_DELTA_FORM.rule: Do not compute E[chi_0] and E[chi_1] separately.
SUFFIX_AVERAGED_DELTA_FORM.positive_reduction: The exact oracle observable is an expected first-adjugate trace pairing, not an expected full characteristic polynomial.
SUFFIX_AVERAGED_DELTA_FORM.untouched_suffix_cancellation: Future random factors acting on completely disjoint coordinates can commute through the local sibling comparison at the leaf-matrix level, but no theorem was obtained showing that all such factors integrate out from the global determinant expectation without changing the surrounding adjugate distribution.
SUFFIX_AVERAGED_DELTA_FORM.remaining_problem: Compute the exact sign of this expected adjugate-trace observable without enumerating exponentially many suffix completions.

FIRST_OVERLAP_BREAK.earliest_structural_location: If the active HPS factor is not the last factor on its current base edge/stage, the next nondegenerate star swap on that same edge already overlaps the distinguished sheet coordinate; otherwise the earliest later factor sharing an endpoint fiber provides the first overlap.
FIRST_OVERLAP_BREAK.one_future_rank_one_update: For a future update K' = K-aa^*, q_x(K')=q_x(K)-C2(x,a;K), where for invertible K, C2(x,a;K)=det(K)[(x^*K^-1 x)(a^*K^-1 a)-(x^*K^-1 a)(a^*K^-1 x)], and the identity extends polynomially to singular K as the corresponding mixed second determinant derivative/second-compound contraction.

antisymmetry_test.scope: This is an exact low-rank algebra counterexample showing that trace-zero sibling antisymmetry alone does not close the observable. It is not claimed to be an explicit STS31 reachable-prefix falsifier and therefore does not falsify an HPS-specific symmetry compression.

FIRST_OVERLAP_BREAK.hierarchy_if_naively_extended: First-adjugate difference -> mixed second-compound difference -> under another generic overlap, higher mixed determinant derivatives/compounds may be required. Fully materializing middle-order compound spaces in dimension Theta(r) is exponential.

PARTIAL_PERMUTATION_CHARACTER_ANALYSIS.source_bridge: Hamaker-Rhoades, Partial permutations and character evaluations, arXiv:2503.17552, gives an algorithm to evaluate irreducible symmetric-group characters on [I,J]=sum_{w(I)=J} w using path/cycle decomposition and Murnaghan-Nakayama machinery.
positive_structure: HPS standard-representation exterior powers are hook representations, so an all-partitions explosion is not automatically forced at the unconditional exterior-power level.
The fixed base has only 465 edge factors, so any r^C number of exact statistics with fixed C is asymptotically legal.
PARTIAL_PERMUTATION_CHARACTER_ANALYSIS.first_exact_mismatch: A conditioned HPS suffix is an ordered weighted product of affine id/transposition factors with stage-dependent probabilities, not in general a uniform extension sum [I,J].
PARTIAL_PERMUTATION_CHARACTER_ANALYSIS.weight_witness: Already in the recursive S_4 suffix, the Bernoulli star factors have probabilities 1/4,1/3,1/2, so bit-pattern completions have unequal weights; a weight-preserving identification with one uniform partial-permutation extension class is not automatic.
PARTIAL_PERMUTATION_CHARACTER_ANALYSIS.matrix_coefficient_issue: The determinant/adjugate observable with fixed earlier labels is noncentral and generally depends on matrix coefficients or products thereof, not only irreducible character values. Hook irreducible dimensions can themselves be exponential near middle exterior degree.

JUCYS_MURPHY_ANALYSIS.source_bridge: Feray, Partial Jucys-Murphy elements and star factorizations, arXiv:0904.4854, develops partial Jucys-Murphy/star-transposition algebra and invariant/central expansions.
JUCYS_MURPHY_ANALYSIS.match: The HPS recursive factors are star-like transpositions involving the newly introduced sheet, so Jucys-Murphy language is structurally relevant.
JUCYS_MURPHY_ANALYSIS.first_exact_mismatch: HPS conditioning leaves an ordered product of individual affine factors (1-p_i)I+p_i(i,k) with nonuniform p_i. These factors are noncentral and generally noncommuting; a frozen prefix destroys the full symmetry used by central/symmetric-polynomial Jucys-Murphy diagonalization.
JUCYS_MURPHY_ANALYSIS.representation_risk: A Gelfand-Tsetlin or irreducible-matrix description is not polynomial merely because the number of hook labels is O(r); relevant representation dimensions and matrix-coefficient state can be exponential.

FIXED_BASE_ORBIT_DP.legal_asymptotic_state: r^C for any constant C depending only on the fixed 186-vertex/465-edge base
FIXED_BASE_ORBIT_DP.positive_fact: Storing a constant number of explicit S_r permutations is itself polynomial-size; the obstacle is exact suffix expectation/sign computation, not raw representation of the already-fixed prefix.
FIXED_BASE_ORBIT_DP.coarse_count_falsifier: Per-edge cycle/support counts alone are not future-equivalent: on a base cycle, assignments with the same individual edge cycle types can have different relative holonomy products (for example equal transpositions can multiply to identity whereas distinct transpositions can produce a 3-cycle), changing lift-cycle structure and potentially the determinant observable.
FIXED_BASE_ORBIT_DP.required_equivalence: STATE(s)=STATE(s') => Delta_s(z_r)=Delta_s'(z_r), or at minimum identical exact three-way sign under the frozen remaining suffix.
FIXED_BASE_ORBIT_DP.result: No r^O(1)-state quotient with this future-equivalence theorem was derived.

COHEN_TRANSFER_ANALYSIS.source: Michael B. Cohen, Ramanujan Graphs in Polynomial Time, arXiv:1604.03544 / FOCS 2016.
COHEN_CLOSURE_PROPERTY: Partially specified object leaves a uniform random completion of one matching/permutation block on unmatched coordinates.
Later fully uniform matching blocks can be removed through an exact linear coefficient transform/finite-free-convolution style step.
A quadrature/Haar replacement exploits the uniform residual symmetry.
The bipartite off-diagonal block structure turns coefficients into sums of squared minors, killing cross terms by symmetry.
A determinant with a constant number of symbolic marking variables encodes the required coefficient sums and is polynomial-time computable.
COHEN_TRANSFER_ANALYSIS.FIRST_MISMATCH_IF_ANY: The remaining current HPS edge label is generated by a weighted ordered product of Bernoulli star swaps, not a uniform permutation completion on one unmatched block; therefore Cohen's exact quadrature premise does not directly apply before the later fully uniform edges are even reached.
COHEN_TRANSFER_ANALYSIS.possible_future_bridge: A new theorem converting the weighted HPS star suffix to a Cohen-compatible uniform/quadrature object could revive this route, but none was source-bound or proved here.

DIRECT_SIGN_FORMULA_SEARCH.sign_reversing_involution: A naive involution toggling a future HPS Bernoulli swap is not weight-preserving when p_i != 1/2, so paired suffix completions generally carry unequal probability mass; cancellation requires additional weighted structure not obtained here.
DIRECT_SIGN_FORMULA_SEARCH.common_interlacing_shortcut: Common interlacing of the sibling polynomials does not imply their difference is real-rooted. Explicitly, f=(x+3)(x+1)^2 and g=x(x+2)^2 have a common degree-2 interlacer with roots -2,-1, but f-g=x^2+3x+3 has negative discriminant. Therefore Delta cannot be assigned a root-location shortcut merely from sibling interlacing.
DIRECT_SIGN_FORMULA_SEARCH.middle_derivative_observation: The leaf Delta is the difference of two rank-one determinant directional derivatives around the common middle. Their individual interlacing/sign information above the middle's largest root does not determine their ordering, so the sign of their difference remains nontrivial.
DIRECT_SIGN_FORMULA_SEARCH.result: No parity, orientation, signed-matching, involution, or other exact Q(r,s) equal to sign(Delta_s(z_r)) was proved.

sources.source: Chris Hall, Doron Puder, William F. Sawin, Ramanujan Coverings of Graphs, arXiv:1506.02335 / Advances in Mathematics 323 (2018)
sources.bound_use: Rank-one random-variable real-rootedness/common interlacing; rank-one middle comparison; recursive S_r construction by binom(r,2) random swaps.
sources.not_imported: No efficient exact evaluator for every partial HPS sign node.

sources.source: Michael B. Cohen, Ramanujan Graphs in Polynomial Time, arXiv:1604.03544 / FOCS 2016
sources.bound_use: Positive example where exact partially specified expected characteristic polynomials are computable by special algebraic closure and symbolic determinant methods.
sources.not_imported: Its special uniform-completion/quadrature closure does not automatically hold for the weighted HPS star suffix.

sources.bound_use: Explicit irreducible-character evaluation on partial-permutation extension sums [I,J].
sources.not_imported: No theorem reducing the weighted conditioned HPS Delta sign to polynomially many such evaluations.

sources.bound_use: Partial Jucys-Murphy/star-transposition algebra as a representation bridge.

HRAIN_RED_TEAM.zero_exactness: No candidate may return approximate near-zero; exact ZERO remains part of the target.
HRAIN_RED_TEAM.unit_cost_firewall: Any exact arithmetic state must include polynomial bit-length proof; unit-cost operations on exponentially large integers/algebraic numbers are not accepted.

COMPLEXITY_CERTIFICATE.matrix_dimension: N=186(r-1)=O(r) for the standard/new-spectrum representation up to the already frozen convention.
COMPLEXITY_CERTIFICATE.leaf_computation: A fixed-completion D_s,omega(z_r)=Tr(adj(K)R) is exact polynomial-bit computable by standard determinant/linear-algebra algorithms on O(r)-dimensional polynomial-bit matrices.
COMPLEXITY_CERTIFICATE.algebraic_point: z_r=rho+epsilon_r, rho=sqrt(14)+sqrt(2), uses the predecessor's fixed-degree algebraic/root-separation encoding with polynomially many bits.
COMPLEXITY_CERTIFICATE.conditional_bottleneck: Naive expectation over the unfixed suffix has exponentially many completions; no r^O(1)-state exact closure was proved for its sign.
COMPLEXITY_CERTIFICATE.compound_warning: Uncompressed kth-compound state has binomial-size middle layers and is not polynomial when k grows with r.
COMPLEXITY_CERTIFICATE.runtime_pass_requirement: r^O(1) bit operations, exponent independent of r

reason: A strict leaf-level Delta compression was proved, but no polynomial exact algorithm for the suffix-averaged three-way sign was obtained.
The first overlap provably introduces a mixed second-compound correction for generic low-rank algebra, killing the naive first-adjugate closure.
Character, Jucys-Murphy, fixed-base DP and Cohen-transfer routes remain either mismatched or missing an exact polynomial closure theorem.
No rigorous impossibility theorem for the entire frozen sign-decision target was established.

BEST_SURVIVING_ROUTE.why: It preserves the strongest proved cancellation: leaf Delta is already only a first-adjugate trace pairing, and the immediately exposed obstruction is one exact mixed-second-compound correction under the first overlapping weighted star swap.

FIRST_EXACT_BROKEN_STEP.statement: The exact leaf observable q_R(K) is not generically closed under K->K-aa^*: its update depends on C2(u,a;K)-C2(v,a;K), which is not determined by q_R(K) alone and is not identically zero from sibling antisymmetry.

EXACT_NEXT_MISSING_LINK.statement: For every reachable frozen HPS sign-oracle prefix, at the first future nondegenerate swap overlapping the active sibling support, determine whether the mixed second-compound correction to the exact Delta observable admits an r^O(1)-bit HPS-specific representation that is sufficient and closed for continued sign computation under the remaining weighted star-swap suffix; otherwise provide an exact reachable-prefix obstruction to the proposed compressed state.
EXACT_NEXT_MISSING_LINK.why_smallest: This is the first algebraic statistic not contained in the proved leaf Delta state. Attacking later compounds before resolving this first overlap would skip the earliest closure obligation.

NEXT_SINGLE_GATE.scope: Preregister only the first-overlap mixed-second-compound closure/falsification problem exposed by this OPEN gate. Do not start its proof automatically and do not reopen the broader sign target, selector composition, SAT, reducer, treewidth, Lane C, holdouts or BA26.
